cli.usage:
usage:
  LANTransferCLI.exe version
  LANTransferCLI.exe serve [--no-code]
  LANTransferCLI.exe devices
  LANTransferCLI.exe send <file|folder>... --to <ip[:port]|name> --code <code> [--dest <folder>] [--parallel N] [--json]
  LANTransferCLI.exe send <file|folder> <ip-or-name> [destination-folder] --code <code>

The receiver shows the pairing code (in its window or with "serve").
Instead of --code you can set the LANTRANSFER_CODE variable.
A receiver started with "serve --no-code" (or with the code turned off in Settings) accepts senders without --code.
Message language: the LANTRANSFER_LANG variable (e.g. en, de, pl).
cli.noFiles: no files to send were given
cli.noCode: no pairing code: pass --code or set LANTRANSFER_CODE
cli.serving: LAN Transfer is receiving files as “{name}” on port {port}
cli.noCodeMode: The pairing code is off: any computer with LAN Transfer on this network can send files here
cli.interrupted: interrupted – run the same command again to resume
